results.title:
The image clearly displays the iconic bitten apple logo. This logo is associated with Apple Inc.. The company was founded in 1976 as Apple Computer Company and later became Apple Inc. in 2007, expanding its focus beyond computers to consumer electronics. The current logo, a bitten apple, has been in use since 1977, with minor variations in color and style over the years.
